headline: Ifis: Bank of Italy approves merger with illimity; Raffaele Zingone named new CEO
summary: The Bank of Italy has approved the merger of illimity Bank into Banca Ifis, to be completed within the year. The combined bank will record about €70 million in deferred tax assets.
why: Banca Ifis is an Italian specialty lender focused on corporate and credit-impaired loans, and illimity is a listed Italian bank focused on special situations. Regulator approval is a key step in completing a bank combination.
